# AdhocX

> AdhocX is a B2B corporate ground-transport platform based in Hyderabad, India. It combines employee transport software (ETS) with a network of verified commercial yellow-plate 4-seater and 7-seater cabs, so companies can run shift commutes, night-shift transport for women employees, executive and airport transfers, and monthly corporate cab rental with GPS tracking and consolidated GST billing.

AdhocX is operated by Estemporaneo Technologies Private Limited.
Headquarters: Level 4, Cyber Gateway, HITEC City, Madhapur, Hyderabad, Telangana 500081, India.
Primary service area: Hyderabad IT corridors (HITEC City, Knowledge City, Mindspace, Gachibowli, Financial District, Kondapur, Madhapur, Nanakramguda, Uppal, Pocharam) and Telangana state.
Website: https://www.adhocx.com
Contact: +91-7893545818 | support@adhocx.com | enterprise@adhocx.com

For the complete technical specification, system architecture, and entity documentation, see [llms-full.txt](https://www.adhocx.com/llms-full.txt).

## Core Platform & Services
- [Employee Transport Services](https://www.adhocx.com/services): Shift pickups and drops, late-night safety, executive transit, and airport transfers for enterprise staff in Hyderabad.
- [Employee Transport Software (ETS)](https://www.adhocx.com/ets): Automated H3 spatial routing and Redis GEO, multi-tenant corporate client portal, employee app, driver app, live GPS tracking, dynamic OTP boarding, and 3-way match billing.
- [Corporate Cab Sourcing & Fleet Rental](https://www.adhocx.com/vendors): Verified 4-seater sedans (Maruti Dzire) and 6/7-seater MUVs (Maruti Ertiga, Toyota Innova Crysta) with strict SLA-backed fulfillment.
- [Industries Served](https://www.adhocx.com/industries): IT & Tech Parks, BPO & GCC 24/7 night shifts, BFSI, Healthcare & Hospital shift transit.
- [Pricing & Rate Cards](https://www.adhocx.com/pricing): Predictable corporate contracts, fixed kilometer and shift package rate cards, zero surge multipliers, and transparent indexation.
- [Safety & Duty of Care](https://www.adhocx.com/safety): Mandatory night escort protocols (8 PM–6 AM), first-pickup/last-drop protection, sub-15s GPS telemetry, Dial 100/112 emergency integration, and 100% yellow-plate verified fleets.

## Applications
- [Corporate Client Portal](https://portal.adhocx.com): Web dashboard for HR and transport desks to ingest rosters (Darwinbox, Workday, SAP, CSV), monitor live trip feeds, manage exceptions, and download GST invoices.
- [Employee Mobile App](https://www.adhocx.com/employee-app): Native iOS and Android application with real-time cab tracking, pickup ETAs, dynamic geofenced OTP boarding, and emergency panic SOS.
- [Driver Partner App](https://www.adhocx.com/driver-app): Native driver app featuring digital trip manifests, turn-by-turn routing, geofenced OTP validation, and automated double-entry instant bank payout ledger.
- [Driver Community & Network](https://www.adhocx.com/drivers): Driver partner registration, compliance requirements, 1-hour bank payouts, and ₹2,000 milestone bonus structure.
